title: Bronze Orbit
logline: A bronze orb turns through a narrow shaft of light as the camera makes a slow, deliberate arc.

scenes.purpose: Reveal the orb's form and metallic color through a controlled camera move.
scenes.action: A small bronze orb hangs motionless while a soft area light defines its curved surface.
scenes.framing: Vertical medium close-up with negative space above and below the orb.
scenes.camera: Slow linear arc from frame 0 to frame 23; no retiming.
scenes.lighting: One warm area key light against a black world background.
